meta.note: one-psim.css is generated from the production ONE.PSIM.Web.DesignSystem tokens.json (DS commit 3a78735, 2026-09-24).

tokens.name: one-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and the side navigation (`bg-canvas`).

tokens.name: one-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, top bar, side navigation, tables (`bg-surface`, `.card`). Primary ground for `one-fg`.

tokens.name: one-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary panels (`.card-muted`), the segmented-control track, quiet zones inside a card.

tokens.name: one-surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Skeletons, neutral badges, avatar/thumbnail placeholders, progress-bar tracks.

tokens.name: one-popup
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers (`.menu`, `.popover`).

tokens.name: one-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialog body (`.dialog`).

tokens.name: one-fg
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on `one-surface`, `one-canvas`, `one-popup`, `one-dialog`.

tokens.name: one-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, helper text, table headers, metadata — on `one-surface` and `one-canvas`. Also the single at-rest tone of standalone icons: tab, nav item, tree row (D-051).

tokens.name: one-fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and chrome icons (the brand mark, captions; nav and tab icons moved to `one-fg-muted`, D-051) on `one-surface`. Light is 4.45:1 on surface — exact from the DS; fine for icons and 11–12px metadata the DS designs it for, not for body copy.

tokens.name: one-fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons of disabled controls. Exempt from contrast by design.

tokens.name: one-fg-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in fields (`::placeholder`). Below 4.5:1 by the DS design — never use for real content.

tokens.name: one-border
tokens.usage: Card, menu and dialog outlines, dividers between header/body/footer, outline-button border. Dark value is 1.46:1 on `one-surface` — exact from the DS; it separates areas, controls get `one-editor-border`.

tokens.name: one-border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger outline where `one-border` is too quiet (Dark: lighter border for emphasis).

tokens.name: one-divider
tokens.usage: DS divider token (white in Light). The kit draws dividers with `one-border`; keep for parity.

tokens.name: one-control-bg
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (`.btn-secondary`).

tokens.name: one-control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of neutral buttons, menu items, clickable table rows.

tokens.name: one-control-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of neutral buttons and clickable rows. Pressed is background only (D-011).

tokens.name: one-control-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled fill of filled buttons and the switch track.

tokens.name: one-selected-neutral
tokens.usage: Selected table row / tree item background (`aria-selected`).

tokens.name: one-editor-bg
tokens.usage: Field rest background (`.field`), checkbox/radio body.

tokens.name: one-editor-hover
tokens.usage: Field hover background.

tokens.name: one-editor-border
tokens.usage: Field rest border.

tokens.name: one-editor-border-hover
tokens.usage: Field hover border.

tokens.name: one-editor-readonly
tokens.usage: Read-only field background (`.field[readonly]`), text in `one-fg-muted`.

tokens.name: one-editor-pressed
tokens.usage: Field pressed background.

tokens.name: one-editor-focus
tokens.usage: Field focused background (with the `one-focus-halo`).

tokens.name: one-editor-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled field and checkbox body.

tokens.name: one-editor-border-pressed
tokens.usage: Field border while pressed.

tokens.name: one-editor-border-focus
tokens.usage: Field border when focused.

tokens.name: one-nav-selected-text
tokens.usage: Selected tab and current side-nav item: label, icon and indicator (the only coloured-label selection, D-031).

tokens.name: one-nav-hover
tokens.usage: Hover background of tabs and side-nav items.

tokens.name: one-nav-selected-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of the current side-nav item and of the selected tab (D-046). In Dark it is darker than rest so the selected label keeps AA.

tokens.name: one-table-row-divider
tokens.usage: Hairline between table rows and list items (`border-row-divider`).

tokens.name: one-accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, checked checkbox/radio/switch, brand blue. Text on it is `one-accent-on`.

tokens.name: one-accent-hover
tokens.usage: DS accent hover step (darker). Buttons use `one-primary-hover` instead.

tokens.name: one-accent-pressed
tokens.usage: DS accent pressed step.

tokens.name: one-accent-emphasis
tokens.usage: Emphasised accent (Dark: brighter blue for marks on dark surfaces).

tokens.name: one-accent-indicator
tokens.usage: Accent indicator line/mark.

tokens.name: one-accent-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `one-accent` and palette-coloured buttons.

tokens.name: one-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft accent ground: current nav item, selected menu item, avatar initials.

tokens.name: one-accent-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of a selected menu item on `one-accent-soft` (Dark: darker than rest, D-046).

tokens.name: one-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button, toggle-on and checked-control hover (lighter step).

tokens.name: one-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button, toggle-on and checked-control pressed.

tokens.name: one-selected-neutral-hover
tokens.usage: Hover over a selected row.

tokens.name: one-selected-neutral-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed on a selected row.

tokens.name: one-selected-indicator
tokens.usage: 3px inset bar of the selected menu item.

tokens.name: one-button-selected-border
tokens.usage: Inset border of a selected (aria-pressed) primary button.

tokens.name: one-link
tokens.usage: Link text `.link` / `.link-action` on `one-surface` (Dark ≥ 6:1, D-041).

tokens.name: one-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover: Light darker, Dark lighter.

tokens.name: one-link-underline
tokens.usage: Underline of an inline `.link` at rest (the link colour at 50%); on hover the underline takes `one-link-hover`. Source writes it as `rgb(r g b / 50%)`.

tokens.name: one-selection-outline
tokens.usage: Outline of unchecked checkbox and radio.

tokens.name: one-selection-outline-disabled
tokens.usage: Outline of disabled selection controls and disabled switch.

tokens.name: one-switch-off-track
tokens.usage: Switch off: track.

tokens.name: one-switch-off-track-hover
tokens.usage: Switch off: track on hover.

tokens.name: one-switch-off-track-pressed
tokens.usage: Switch off: track pressed.

tokens.name: one-switch-off-border
tokens.usage: Switch off: border (pinned in every state).

tokens.name: one-switch-off-thumb
tokens.usage: Switch off: thumb.

tokens.name: one-info
tokens.usage: Info status solid colour (dots, borders such as `aria-invalid` for danger).

tokens.name: one-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info badge / alert ground (`.badge-info`). Text on it: `one-info-text`.

tokens.name: one-info-text
tokens.usage: Info text on `one-info-bg` (`.badge-info`).

tokens.name: one-info-icon
tokens.usage: Info icon colour on `one-surface`.

tokens.name: one-success
tokens.usage: Success solid (`#20D300`). Too light for text on Light surfaces — dots and fills only; text uses `one-success-text`/`-icon`.

tokens.name: one-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success badge / alert ground (`.badge-success`). Text on it: `one-success-text`.

tokens.name: one-success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on `one-success-bg` (`.badge-success`).

tokens.name: one-success-icon
tokens.usage: Success icon colour on `one-surface`.

tokens.name: one-warning
tokens.usage: Warning solid. Not for text on Light surfaces — fills only; text uses `one-warning-text`/`-icon`.

tokens.name: one-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning badge / alert ground (`.badge-warning`). Text on it: `one-warning-text`.

tokens.name: one-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on `one-warning-bg` (`.badge-warning`).

tokens.name: one-warning-icon
tokens.usage: Warning icon colour on `one-surface`.

tokens.name: one-danger
tokens.usage: Danger: error text, invalid field border, overdue values (`text-danger`) on `one-surface`.

tokens.name: one-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Danger badge / alert ground (`.badge-danger`). Text on it: `one-danger-text`.

tokens.name: one-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger text on `one-danger-bg` (`.badge-danger`).

tokens.name: one-danger-icon
tokens.usage: Danger icon colour on `one-surface`.

tokens.name: one-focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring of buttons, links, tabs, menu items, checkboxes (offset 2px).

tokens.name: one-focus-halo
tokens.usage: 2px halo around a focused field — fields use the halo, never a ring (D-025).

tokens.name: one-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the drawer.

tokens.name: one-palette-red
tokens.usage: Escalation actions (`.btn-red`), critical-priority category, chart series. Scheme-independent; white text on it.

tokens.name: one-palette-red-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `one-palette-red` buttons (lighter step; pressed returns to rest).

tokens.name: one-palette-orange
tokens.usage: Redirect/secondary coloured actions (`.btn-orange`), high-priority category. Scheme-independent. White text on it is 2.6:1 — below 4.5:1; kept as the source defines it (D-026), use bold/large labels or icons.

tokens.name: one-palette-orange-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `one-palette-orange` buttons (lighter step; pressed returns to rest).

tokens.name: one-palette-amber
tokens.usage: Category / chart series; darkest-text badge (`.badge-amber`). Scheme-independent. White text on it is 1.9:1 — below 4.5:1; kept as the source defines it (D-026), use bold/large labels or icons.

tokens.name: one-palette-amber-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `one-palette-amber` buttons (lighter step; pressed returns to rest).

tokens.name: one-palette-green
tokens.usage: Coloured action (`.btn-green`), online/progress fills. Not beside a success status (D-039). Scheme-independent. White text on it is 4.3:1 — below 4.5:1; kept as the source defines it (D-026), use bold/large labels or icons.

tokens.name: one-palette-green-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `one-palette-green` buttons (lighter step; pressed returns to rest).

tokens.name: one-palette-teal
tokens.usage: Medium-priority category, chart series. Scheme-independent. White text on it is 4.4:1 — below 4.5:1; kept as the source defines it (D-026), use bold/large labels or icons.

tokens.name: one-palette-teal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `one-palette-teal` buttons (lighter step; pressed returns to rest).

tokens.name: one-palette-purple
tokens.usage: Category / ownership badge, chart series. Scheme-independent; white text on it.

tokens.name: one-palette-purple-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `one-palette-purple` buttons (lighter step; pressed returns to rest).

tokens.name: one-palette-magenta
tokens.usage: Category / chart series. Scheme-independent; white text on it.

tokens.name: one-palette-magenta-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `one-palette-magenta` buttons (lighter step; pressed returns to rest).

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: KPI values (`.kpi-value`) and rare hero numbers. Tabular figures for numbers.

styles.name: text-heading-lg
styles.usage: Page title on wide screens / large section heading.

styles.name: text-heading-md
styles.usage: Page title in the top bar, dialog title (`.dialog-title`).

styles.name: text-heading-sm
styles.usage: Card and section titles, side-nav brand text.

styles.name: text-body-lg
styles.usage: Long-form text in a roomy layout.

styles.name: text-body-md
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, menu items, form values.

styles.name: text-body-md-medium
styles.usage: Emphasised row titles, empty-state titles, incident names.

styles.name: text-body-sm
styles.usage: Dense rows, IDs in tables, dense fields.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Metadata under titles, timestamps, footers, menu-item descriptions.

tokens.name: one-radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, checkboxes, tab top corners, skeletons.

tokens.name: one-radius-container
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, `.card-muted`, thumbnails.

tokens.name: one-radius-window
tokens.usage: Cards (`.card`) and dialogs.

tokens.name: one-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, radios, switches, avatars, progress bars.

tokens.name: one-shadow
tokens.usage: Only floating surfaces: menus, popovers, dialogs. Cards carry a border, no shadow.
